Town of Elmridge — Elmridge permit system RFP 2026-14

Mandatory requirements (RFP, p. 4)
M-1: The system must keep every permit record for seven years.
M-2: The system must let applicants apply and pay online.
M-3: The system must export every record in an open format.

Desirable requirements (RFP, p. 6)
D-1: Inspectors can record visits from a phone.
D-2: Applicants receive status updates by email.

Evaluation criteria and method (RFP, p. 9)
| Ref | Criterion | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| C-1 | Fit to the desirable requirements | 50 |
| C-2 | Implementation approach | 30 |
| C-3 | Price | 20 |
Mandatory requirements are evaluated pass/fail by the panel.
The panel will score each criterion from 0 to 5 and apply the weights.
Shortlisted bidders may be invited to present.
